heading: This Afternoon
text: Chance of a few passing rain showers, mainly over the Greens. Highs from the low 40s north, nearing 50 in the south. West wind 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Increasing chance of rain showers, mixing with snow overnight then tapering off southwest to northeast. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s. Light west wind.

heading: Sunday
text: A mix of sun and clouds, more sun shouth. Highs in the 40s to near 50, in the low to mid 50s in the warmer southern valleys. Light and variable wind.
